payload.title: MP-CGA-004: Agent — context truncation and configurable topNewsCount
payload.body:
**ID:** MP-CGA-004 | **Priority:** P0 | **PRD refs:** FR8 | **Status:** draft
**Group:** MP Content Generation Agent (`mp-content-generation-agent`)

---

# Agent — context truncation and configurable topNewsCount

## Summary

The agent currently concatenates the full text of all data sources into the LLM prompt (no truncation) and hardcodes `topNewsCount` to 3 in both the prompt instruction and the `slice(0, 3)` call. This ticket wires the `context.maxCharsPerSource` and `context.maxTotalContextChars` config values to truncate source text before the LLM call, and replaces the hardcoded `3` with `output.topNewsCount` from config, allowing operators to tune output size without code deploys.

## Scope

- In scope:
  - Before building the LLM prompt, truncate each source's text to `config.context.maxCharsPerSource` characters (deterministic order: truncate from the tail of each source string; document this).
  - After per-source truncation, if the combined source text exceeds `config.context.maxTotalContextChars`, drop sources from the end of the list until the total fits; document the drop order (last source removed first — preserve order of relevance from `getDataSourcesForTicker`).
  - Replace the hardcoded instruction "exactly 3 top news items" in the prompt with `config.output.topNewsCount`; replace `slice(0, 3)` with `slice(0, config.output.topNewsCount)`.
  - Extend `parseNewsletterJson` / the Zod output schema to validate that the number of returned `topNews` items does not exceed `topNewsCount` (allow fewer if the LLM returns less; the PRD says the instruction asks for exactly N — validate ≤ N and document the lenient rule).
  - Unit tests: truncation logic (single source truncated, total context cap, no truncation needed), topNewsCount applied to slice and prompt.
- Out of scope:
  - Token-budget-based context management (the PRD documents chars-based as the v1 approach; token-based is an optional future enhancement).
  - Any retry logic (MP-CGA-005).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Source text exceeding `maxCharsPerSource` is truncated to exactly `maxCharsPerSource` characters before inclusion in the user prompt.
- [ ] When the combined truncated source text exceeds `maxTotalContextChars`, sources are dropped from the end of the list until the total fits; at least one source is always included if sources are non-empty (do not drop all sources — if a single source exceeds the total limit, truncate it to `maxTotalContextChars`).
- [ ] The LLM system/user prompt instructs the model to return exactly `topNewsCount` items (interpolated from config, not hardcoded).
- [ ] `slice(0, topNewsCount)` replaces `slice(0, 3)` in the response processing path.
- [ ] The Zod output validator accepts responses with ≤ `topNewsCount` items in `topNews`; it rejects responses with more than `topNewsCount` items.
- [ ] Truncation order is documented in a code comment at the truncation site.
- [ ] Unit tests (following `vitest-unit-testing` skill): per-source truncation, total-context cap (some sources dropped), no truncation needed (all within limits), topNewsCount=5 produces a prompt instructing 5 items and a slice of 5.
- [ ] `pnpm code-quality` passes with no new errors.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-CGA-003 (config schema must include `context` and `output` groups)
- Blocks: none (MP-CGA-007 reads outcome but does not depend on this ticket's specific logic)

## Stacked delivery

This ticket changes agent runtime behavior but is gated entirely behind the config values — when config uses the defaults (`maxCharsPerSource: 8000`, `maxTotalContextChars: 100000`, `topNewsCount: 3`), behavior is identical to today's hardcoded values. No feature flag is required.

**Merge order:** Ship after MP-CGA-003. Can be developed in parallel with MP-CGA-005 and MP-CGA-006 if branching from the same MP-CGA-003 base.

## Notes

- Extract the truncation logic into a dedicated pure function (e.g. `src/lib/truncate-sources.ts`) per the `organized-src-structure` skill. This makes unit testing straightforward without mocking the full agent pipeline.
- The `userPromptTemplate` from config (MP-CGA-003) uses the `{{sourceSummaries}}` placeholder. After truncation, interpolate the truncated+joined source text into `{{sourceSummaries}}` before calling the LLM.
- If a source's text is already within `maxCharsPerSource`, it is not modified.
- Follow `vitest-unit-testing` skill: Setup / Act / Assert, `vi.restoreAllMocks()` in `afterEach`, no false positives.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/content-generation-agent-prd.md
